payload.reason: The evidence discusses the transfer of encoders pretrained on artificial languages to natural language tasks without parameter updates, specifically mentioning the types of structural knowledge that can be transferred.

claims.text: Encoders pretrained on artificial languages can be transferred to natural language tasks such as natural language inference, question answering, and semantic role labeling without parameter updates.
The transfer of knowledge from artificial languages to natural languages includes understanding position-aware context dependence, which is beneficial for various NLP tasks.
